scene: Inside the aviary, clockwork hummingbirds whirr beneath arched brass rafters.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the aviary interior. Far left, a gold winding key dangles from an overhead wire. Centre-left stands the girl in windbreaker and shorts, holding her sketchbook. In the centre sits a brass pedestal supporting a glowing glass seed hopper. Far right, a spiral copper ladder rises toward an open roof hatch.
shown: a dangling gold winding key swinging from an iron wire far left
a glass seed hopper on a pedestal glowing softly in the centre
a spiral copper ladder leading up through an open hatch far right
